chunks: From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Kufi, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Fadhal, from Ghalib ibn Uthman, from Rawh ibn Abd al-Rahim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) regarding the prayer of the eclipse: Is it prayed in congregation? He said, 'In congregation and not in congregation.'
ai.seo_question: Is the eclipse prayer required to be performed in congregation or can it be done individually?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the eclipse prayer (Salat al-Kusuf/Khusuf) is not restricted to congregational performance, affirming its validity both individually and in groups. This ruling underscores the flexibility of this supererogatory prayer, allowing believers to fulfill the Sunnah regardless of their social setting or ability to gather. The transmission chain highlights the reliability of the Kufi school of hadith in preserving these practical jurisprudential nuances.
